pageTitle: Pennsylvania Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What Are the Requirements to Buy Lottery Tickets in Pennsylvania?
items.answer:
Players over 18 can buy tickets and Pennsylvania lottery scratch cards and register with iLottery. Online purchase of lottery tickets is impossible, but registering an account gives you access to iLottery games that you can play for money. You can also play these games on the Pennsylvania lottery app.

The app provides info on Pennsylvania lottery results and Pennsylvania lottery codes. It also acts as a Pennsylvania lottery ticket scanner that lets you check your tickets.

items.question: What Lottery Games Can You Play in Pennsylvania?
items.answer:
In addition to the statewide games like Powerball and Pennsylvania lottery Mega Millions, the lottery in Pennsylvania offers seven different games. These are as follows: 

Match 6 lets you select six numbers from 1 to 49, while in Cash4Life you have to select five numbers from 1 to 60. Cash 5 requires five numbers from 1 to 43. Pick 5, Pick 4, Pick 3 and Pick 2 requires different play styles as part of your betting. For the most part though, it’s about picking the number of digits required in the name and adding your personal touch.

items.question: Where and How Do I Claim Winnings from the Pennsylvania Lottery?
items.answer:
When the Pennsylvania lottery numbers match your selection, it’s time to claim. Winners can claim all prizes up to $2500 at participating retailers, or by mail. Prizes over $2500 require completing a claim form that winners mail to the lottery with the signed ticket.

Players can claim Jackpot prizes for Powerball, Mega Millions, and Cash4Life in person at lottery headquarters. Claims generally expire about one year after the draw or the end-sale date. Your check should reach you in four weeks.

items.question: What Are the Odds of Winning the Pennsylvania Lottery?
items.answer:
Winning the Mega Millions jackpot comes at odds of 1 in 302 million. In the case of Powerball, it’s 1 in 175 million. Other odds are as follows:

 

Match 6: 1 in 4.6 million

Cash4Life: 1 in 21.9 million

Cash 5: 1 in 962 598

Pick 5: 1 in 100 000

Pick 4: 1 in 10 000

Pick 3: 1 in 1000

Pick 2: 1 in 100

items.question: What’s the Biggest Pennsylvania Lottery Win?
items.answer: In 2018, a Powerball ticket bought in Manheim, Lancaster County, won a $456.7 million jackpot.  The name of the individual is not known. The prize was claimed by the Emerald Legacy Trust, created by the winner for anonymity.

items.question: When Is the Pennsylvania Lottery Results Draw?
items.answer:
The results of the Pennsylvania Lottery become available as follows:

 

Match 6: Daily at 6:59 pm

Cash4Life: Mondays and Thursdays at 9 pm 

Cash 5: Daily at 6:59 pm

Pick 5, Pick 4, Pick 3, and Pick 2: Daily at 1:35 pm and 6:59 pm

items.question: What Is the Pennsylvania Lottery Second Chance?
items.answer:
Players access Pennsylvania lottery Second Chance through the VIP Players Club. Club members have more opportunities to win from previously

non-winning tickets. You can use the Pennsylvania lottery app to scan tickets to enter them for Second Chance.

items.question: Do I Have to Pay Tax on Pennsylvania Lottery Winnings?
items.answer: For wins over $5,000, Pennsylvania Lottery winners pay a state tax of 3.07% and the standard federal tax of 24%
